stem:
During a science club meeting, four students share questions they are curious about.

Which questions are focused scientific questions that can guide careful observation, experimentation, and explanation?

1  Meera asks: "Why is the world such an interesting place?"
2  Arjun asks: "Does dosa batter rise faster at 30°C or at 20°C in my kitchen?"
3  Kavya asks: "Why do I feel happy when it rains?"
4  Rohan asks: "Does hibiscus flower extract change colour more in lemon juice or in soap solution?"

statements.text: Meera asks: "Why is the world such an interesting place?"
Arjun asks: "Does dosa batter rise faster at 30°C or at 20°C in my kitchen?"
Kavya asks: "Why do I feel happy when it rains?"
Rohan asks: "Does hibiscus flower extract change colour more in lemon juice or in soap solution?"

teacher.key_rationale: Statements 2 and 4 are focused questions with identifiable variables that can be tested by careful observation or experiment (temperature versus batter rising; acidic versus basic solution versus colour change). Statement 1 is too broad and unfocused to guide an investigation, and statement 3 concerns a personal feeling with no testable variable. Hence 2 and 4 only, key C.
